title: Nonlinear Optical Mechanisms in Photonic Structures
chapter_argument: This section establishes that nonlinear optical effects in photonic crystal and waveguide structures are governed by third-order susceptibility and phase-matching conditions, and that recent fabrication advances have enabled sub-millimeter interaction lengths with conversion efficiencies competitive with bulk crystals.
scope_description: Nonlinear optics in integrated photonic platforms: waveguides, photonic crystals, resonators. Focus on chi-3 effects (Kerr, SPM, FWM) and phase matching.
scope_guardrails: Exclude metasurfaces unless used as phase-matching elements
Exclude free-space bulk crystal nonlinear optics
Exclude microwave and THz nonlinear effects
